title: Automated Harmfulness Testing for Code Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the generation of 'harmful' and 'unethical' content in Code LLMs. It explicitly references moral philosophy (Mencius and Aristotle's theories of innate goodness) to ground its behavioral assumptions and frames the entire testing framework as a means to ensure the 'responsible use' and 'alignment' of AI systems with respect to societal values.
